com.betwayafrica.za._comment_default: The default account, used when the device running has no assignment below. A single-device setup needs nothing more than these two fields plus logoutSteps.
com.betwayafrica.za._comment_parallel: Only needed to run several devices AT THE SAME TIME. Each device must sign in as a different account: sharing one account across concurrent runs means they read each other's balance and bet history, and the app may invalidate the first session when the second logs in. Enter the mobile number the way the login field takes it - Betway ZA shows a fixed '+27' prefix beside the field, so it wants the local 9 digits, not the 27... form.

logoutSteps.expectedResult: Any still-in-flight login request (the last test case's final step may have only just submitted it) has time to complete before the logged-in check below runs — otherwise this teardown can run before the session actually exists and wrongly treat it as nothing to log out of.
The logged-in header (Deposit button) is present, meaning there is an active session to log out of.

Scrolls the drawer until the Log Out row materializes. The search selector MUST be scoped to the navTitle id: an unscoped text("Log Out") matches any node carrying that text anywhere on screen and stops instantly without scrolling, so teardown silently fails and leaves the account logged in. Optional because the row may already be in view, and because this existence check reports the scrollable container rather than the row either way.
The scroll settles before Log Out is tapped.
The Log Out row is present in the drawer. Matched on the drawer row's own navTitle id rather than on text alone, so it cannot bind to a same-titled element elsewhere on screen.
The app finishes returning to a logged-out home screen.
The logged-out header (Login button) is visible again.
